name: artel
description: Artel — Your fleet's smart notepad — one that learns. Shared memory your agents write to and get back at the right moment, plus a ledger showing what the work cost and which chores keep getting done by hand. Self-hosted.

plugins.name: artel
plugins.description: Ambient shared memory for Claude Code: injects the note you need when you need it — your last handoff at session start, relevant notes on each prompt, file-anchored gotchas before you edit — and writes the session back afterwards, including what it cost. Points at your own self-hosted Artel via ARTEL_URL / ARTEL_AGENT_ID / ARTEL_API_KEY.
